vsm1.3:27.2: yo tāva ayaṃ lokiyalokuttaravasena duvidhotiādīsu ariyamaggasampayutto samādhi vutto,
vsm1.3:27.4: Paññāya hi bhāvitāya so bhāvito hoti.
vsm1.3:27.5: Tasmā taṃ sandhāya evaṃ bhāvetabboti na kiñci visuṃ vadāma.
vsm1.3:28.2: so vuttanayena sīlāni visodhetvā suparisuddhe sīle patiṭṭhitena
vsm1.3:28.3: yvāssa dasasu palibodhesu palibodho atthi, taṃ upacchinditvā
vsm1.3:28.5: attano cariyānukūlaṃ cattālīsāya kammaṭṭhānesu aññataraṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā
vsm1.3:28.6: samādhibhāvanāya ananurūpaṃ vihāraṃ pahāya anurūpe vihāre viharantena
vsm1.3:28.7: khuddakapalibodhupacchedaṃ katvā sabbaṃ bhāvanāvidhānaṃ aparihāpentena bhāvetabboti ayamettha saṅkhepo.
vsm1.3:29.2: yaṃ tāva vuttaṃ ‘‘yvāssa dasasu palibodhesu palibodho atthi, taṃ upacchinditvā’’ti, ettha –
vsm1.3:29.3: Āvāso ca kulaṃ lābho, gaṇo kammañca pañcamaṃ;
vsm1.3:29.4: Addhānaṃ ñāti ābādho, gantho iddhīti te dasāti. –
vsm1.3:29.5: Ime dasa palibodhā nāma. Tattha āvāsoyeva āvāsapalibodho. Esa nayo kulādīsu.
vsm1.3:30.1: Tattha āvāsoti ekopi ovarako vuccati ekampi pariveṇaṃ sakalopi saṅghārāmo.
vsm1.3:30.3: Yo panettha navakammādīsu ussukkaṃ vā āpajjati,
vsm1.3:30.5: yena kenaci vā kāraṇena apekkhavā paṭibaddhacitto,
vsm1.3:31.1: Tatridaṃ vatthu – dve kira kulaputtā anurādhapurā nikkhamitvā anupubbena thūpārāme pabbajiṃsu.
vsm1.3:31.2: Tesu eko dve mātikā paguṇā katvā
vsm1.3:31.6: Pācinakhaṇḍarājigato tattha ciraṃ vasitvā thero hutvā cintesi
vsm1.3:31.9: Pavisantaṃyeva ca naṃ disvā samānavassikatthero paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā vattaṃ akāsi.
vsm1.3:32.2: ‘‘idāni me sahāyo sappiṃ vā phāṇitaṃ vā pānakaṃ vā pesessati.
vsm1.3:32.6: Tampi adisvā ‘‘pahiṇantā natthi, paviṭṭhassa maññe dassatī’’ti
vsm1.3:32.8: Te dve ekaṃ vīthiṃ caritvā uḷuṅkamattaṃ yāguṃ labhitvā āsanasālāyaṃ nisīditvā piviṃsu.
vsm1.3:33.3: bhattakāle idāni manussā paṇītaṃ bhattaṃ dassantī’’ti,
vsm1.3:33.4: tato bhattakālepi piṇḍāya caritvā laddhameva bhuñjitvā
vsm1.3:33.5: itaro āha – ‘‘kiṃ, bhante, sabbakālaṃ evaṃ yāpethā’’ti?
vsm1.3:33.6: Āmāvusoti. Bhante, pācinakhaṇḍarāji phāsukā, tattha gacchāmāti.
vsm1.3:33.9: Itaro āha – ‘‘kiṃ pana, bhante, imaṃ maggaṃ paṭipannatthā’’ti? Nanu tvamāvuso, pācinakhaṇḍarājiyā vaṇṇaṃ abhāsīti?
vsm1.3:33.10: Kiṃ pana, bhante, tumhākaṃ ettakaṃ kālaṃ vasitaṭṭhāne na koci atirekaparikkhāro atthīti?
vsm1.3:33.11: Āmāvuso mañcapīṭhaṃ saṅghikaṃ, taṃ paṭisāmitameva, aññaṃ kiñci natthīti.
vsm1.3:33.12: Mayhaṃ pana, bhante, kattaradaṇḍo telanāḷi upāhanatthavikā ca tatthevāti.
vsm1.3:33.13: Tayāvuso, ekadivasaṃ vasitvā ettakaṃ ṭhapitanti? Āma, bhante.
vsm1.3:34.1: So pasannacitto theraṃ vanditvā ‘‘tumhādisānaṃ, bhante, sabbattha araññavāsoyeva.
vsm1.3:34.7: Idheva tumhe vasathā’’ti dutiyadivase pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā sayameva agamāsīti.
vsm1.3:35.3: ‘‘sukhitesu sukhito’’tiādinā (vibha. 888; saṃ. ni. 4.241) nayena saṃsaṭṭhassa viharato palibodho hoti,
vsm1.3:35.4: so kulamānusakehi vinā dhammassavanāya sāmantavihārampi na gacchati.
vsm1.3:36.4: Therabhaginīpi upāsikā sadā theraṃ tassa pavattiṃ pucchati.
vsm1.3:36.5: Thero ekadivasaṃ daharaṃ ānessāmīti rohaṇābhimukho pāyāsi.
vsm1.3:37.2: upajjhāyaṃ dāni passitvā upāsikāya ca pavattiṃ ñatvā āgamissāmī’’ti
vsm1.3:37.5: So aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle therassa vattaṃ katvā ‘‘kuhiṃ yāsī’’ti pucchito tamatthaṃ ārocesi.
vsm1.3:37.9: gaccha tvaṃ, ahaṃ pana idheva imaṃ vassaṃ vasissāmīti taṃ uyyojesi.
vsm1.3:38.1: Athassa pitā dutiyadivase āgantvā ‘‘kassa, bhante, amhākaṃ senāsanaṃ patta’’nti pucchanto
vsm1.3:38.4: ‘‘bhante, amhākaṃ senāsane vassaṃ upagatassa vattaṃ atthī’’ti.
vsm1.3:38.6: Temāsaṃ amhākaṃyeva ghare bhikkhaṃ gahetvā pavāretvā gamanakāle āpucchitabbanti.
vsm1.3:38.9: ‘‘amhākaṃ āvāse eko āgantuko ayyo upagato sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo’’ti āha.
vsm1.3:38.10: Upāsikā ‘‘sādhū’’ti sampaṭicchitvā paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādesi.
vsm1.3:38.11: Daharopi bhattakāle ñātigharaṃ agamāsi. Na naṃ koci sañjāni.
vsm1.3:39.5: dutiyadivase ghareyeva bhojetvā telanāḷiṃ pūretvā ekaṃ guḷapiṇḍaṃ navahatthañca sāṭakaṃ datvā
vsm1.3:40.1: Upajjhāyopissa pavāretvā paṭipathaṃ āgacchanto pubbe diṭṭhaṭṭhāneyeva taṃ addasa.
vsm1.3:40.2: So aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle therassa vattaṃ akāsi.
vsm1.3:40.3: Atha naṃ thero pucchi ‘‘kiṃ, bhaddamukha, diṭṭhā te upāsikā’’ti?
vsm1.3:40.5: tena telena therassa pāde makkhetvā guḷena pānakaṃ katvā tampi sāṭakaṃ therasseva datvā
vsm1.3:40.6: theraṃ vanditvā ‘‘mayhaṃ, bhante, rohaṇaṃyeva sappāya’’nti agamāsi.
vsm1.3:40.7: Theropi vihāraṃ āgantvā dutiyadivase koraṇḍakagāmaṃ pāvisi.
vsm1.3:41.1: Upāsikāpi ‘‘mayhaṃ bhātā mama puttaṃ gahetvā idāni āgacchatī’’ti sadā maggaṃ olokayamānāva tiṭṭhati.
vsm1.3:41.3: ‘‘mato me maññe putto, ayaṃ thero ekakova āgacchatī’’ti
vsm1.3:41.5: Thero ‘‘nūna daharo appicchatāya attānaṃ ajānāpetvāva gato’’ti
vsm1.3:42.2: puttena gatadisābhimukhā urena nipajjitvā namassamānā āha –
vsm1.3:42.3: ‘‘mayhaṃ puttasadisaṃ vata maññe bhikkhuṃ kāyasakkhiṃ katvā bhagavā rathavinītapaṭipadaṃ (ma. ni. 1.252 ādayo),
vsm1.3:42.6: catupaccayasantosabhāvanārāmatādīpakaṃ mahāariyavaṃsapaṭipadañca (a. ni. 4.28; dī. ni. 3.309) desesi.
vsm1.3:42.10: Evarūpassa mātāpitaropi palibodhā na honti, pageva aññaṃ upaṭṭhākakula’’nti.
vsm1.3:43.3: Puññavantassa hi bhikkhuno gatagataṭṭhāne manussā mahāparivāre paccaye denti.
vsm1.3:43.4: So tesaṃ anumodento dhammaṃ desento samaṇadhammaṃ kātuṃ na okāsaṃ labhati.
vsm1.3:43.5: Aruṇuggamanato yāva paṭhamayāmo, tāva manussasaṃsaggo na upacchijjati.
vsm1.3:43.7: ‘‘bhante, asuko upāsako upāsikā amacco amaccadhītā tumhākaṃ dassanakāmā’’ti vadanti,
vsm1.3:43.11: Tena gaṇaṃ pahāya yattha naṃ na jānanti, tattha ekakena caritabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:44.2: yo tassa uddesaṃ vā paripucchaṃ vā dento samaṇadhammassa okāsaṃ na labhati,
vsm1.3:44.5: Sace tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahu gahitaṃ hoti, appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ,
vsm1.3:44.8: yojanato paraṃ agantvā antoyojanaparicchede aññaṃ gaṇavācakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā
vsm1.3:44.11: ‘‘mayhamāvuso, ekaṃ kiccaṃ atthi, tumhe yathāphāsukaṭṭhānāni gacchathā’’ti gaṇaṃ pahāya
vsm1.3:45.5: Sopi evaṃ upacchinditabbo, sace appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti niṭṭhapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:45.7: saṅghikañce navakammaṃ, saṅghassa vā saṅghabhārahārakabhikkhūnaṃ vā niyyādetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:46.2: Yassa hi katthaci pabbajjāpekkho vā hoti,
vsm1.3:46.4: Sace taṃ alabhanto na sakkoti adhivāsetuṃ, araññaṃ pavisitvā samaṇadhammaṃ karontassapi
vsm1.3:46.6: tasmā gantvā taṃ kiccaṃ tīretvāva samaṇadhamme ussukkaṃ kātabbanti.
vsm1.3:47.3: Te gilānā imassa palibodhā honti, tasmā so palibodho upaṭṭhahitvā tesaṃ pākatikakaraṇena upacchinditabbo.
vsm1.3:48.1: Tattha upajjhāyo tāva gilāno sace lahuṃ na vuṭṭhāti, yāvajīvampi paṭijaggitabbo.
vsm1.3:49.2: Sacepi hi te rajje ṭhitā honti, puttato ca upaṭṭhānaṃ paccāsīsanti, kātabbameva.
vsm1.3:49.3: Atha tesaṃ bhesajjaṃ natthi, attano santakaṃ dātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:49.5: Bhātubhaginīnaṃ pana tesaṃ santakameva yojetvā dātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:49.6: Sace natthi attano santakaṃ tāvakālikaṃ datvā pacchā labhantena gaṇhitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:49.8: Aññātakassa bhaginisāmikassa bhesajjaṃ neva kātuṃ na dātuṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:49.9: ‘‘Tuyhaṃ sāmikassa dehī’’ti vatvā pana bhaginiyā dātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:49.11: Tesaṃ pana puttā imassa ñātakā evāti tesaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatīti.
vsm1.3:50.2: So bādhayamāno palibodho hoti, tasmā bhesajjakaraṇena upacchinditabbo.
vsm1.3:50.3: Sace pana katipāhaṃ bhesajjaṃ karontassapi na vūpasammati,
vsm1.3:50.5: taṃyeva hi posento anamatagge saṃsāravaṭṭe dukkhaṃ pattoti attabhāvaṃ garahitvā samaṇadhammo kātabboti.
